description.en: Adds the "Relay key" account type: accounts of an Anthropic-compatible relay (your own Base URL and key) that serve /v1/messages and /v1/messages/count_tokens together with the other account types of a group. Declares no endpoints and no prices.
description.zh: 新增"中转 Key"账号类型：Anthropic 兼容中转站的账号（自定义 Base URL 和 Key），与分组里其他类型的账号一起为 /v1/messages 和 /v1/messages/count_tokens 提供服务。不声明端点和价格。

description.en: Key of an Anthropic-compatible relay. Requests go to <Base URL>/v1/messages with the key in x-api-key.
description.zh: Anthropic 兼容中转站的 Key。请求发往 <Base URL>/v1/messages，Key 放在 x-api-key 中。

reason.zh: 注册"中转 Key"账号类型

reason.en: Read the Base URL and key of relay key accounts to build upstream requests
reason.zh: 读取中转 Key 账号的 Base URL 与 Key 以构造上游请求
